YunX-Desktop cloud-drive resolver — source provenance
====================================================

Upstream project : https://github.com/tidain/YunX-Desktop
License          : GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0)
                   full text in LICENSE.txt (this directory)
Snapshot         : main branch @ 00a030f7 (tag v1.3.4, 2026-11-13 11:22 +0800);
                   downloaded 2026-11-13 21:22
Source archive   : H:/work/YunX-Desktop-main-1.3.4.zip (local working copy;
                   SHA-256 44c4678614042df59ca0337f344fe90ba5336aca70787f7ccf10dd22b974eb7d)
                   unpacked  : H:/work/YunX-Desktop-main-1.3.4/
                   codeload: https://codeload.github.com/tidain/YunX-Desktop/zip/refs/heads/main
Previous snapshot: v1.3.3 era — H:/work/YunX-Desktop-main.zip
                   (SHA-256 878bbc83d0ac6017b921cc9c0dafa865c031682eba2256b34d455e83e65bcbd9)

v1.3.3 -> v1.3.4 upstream diff reviewed on 2026-11-13: 7 commits, 8 files
(version.txt, desktop/build.gradle.kts, BaiduCloudViewModel.kt,
data/download/DownloadManager.kt, DownloadListLayout.kt (new),
ui/screens/DownloadScreen.kt + 2 test files). NONE of the 47 ported resolver
files changed UPSTREAM, so no re-port was required.
IMPORTANT: that statement concerns the upstream snapshot only. The DOWNSTREAM
working tree does contain local modifications — see "Downstream changes" below.
Until the 2026-11-14 audit (docs/CLOUD_DRIVE_DIFF.md §4/§5) most of them were
not recorded in this file, which made the phrase "verbatim" misleading and did
not meet AGPL-3.0's requirement to mark changed files.

Ported into KtDownload on branch cloud_drive_download.
All files carry a header identifying the upstream source and the AGPL-3.0 license.
On 2026-11-14 the header of all 47 ported files (+2 adapted JCEF files) was
corrected from "release v1.3.3 era" to "main branch @ 00a030f7 (tag v1.3.4)",
matching the snapshot declared on line 7.

Package layout: the ported files were originally kept verbatim under the upstream
package names (com.yunx.app.*) to ease diffing. On 2026-11-13 they were relocated
into KtDownload's single package tree (com.yunx.app.data.* -> top.mcly99.dl.data.*,
com.yunx.app.util -> top.mcly99.dl.utils, com.yunx.app.AppContext ->
top.mcly99.dl.data.AppContext). The relocation is mechanical: package and import
statements only, no logic change. To diff against a new upstream release, match by
file name rather than by package path.

Modifications
-------------
- 2026-11-13 package relocation (mechanical, no logic change):
  com.yunx.app.data.{network,repository,db} -> top.mcly99.dl.data.{network,repository,db};
  com.yunx.app.util.Log -> top.mcly99.dl.utils.Log;
  com.yunx.app.AppContext -> top.mcly99.dl.data.AppContext.
- Added the provenance/license header to every ported file.
- Added small compatibility shims (clearly marked) replacing upstream app services:
  AppContext.kt (java.util.prefs replaced by a properties file — the jlink
  runtime image does not include java.prefs), util/Log.kt + DiagnosticLog.kt
  (forwarded to KtDownload AppLogger), data/db/XunleiAccountEntity.kt,
  data/repository/ILanzouAccountRepository.kt (account DB not ported).
- Upstream Compose UI, SQLite persistence, download engine and player were NOT
  ported. KtDownload calls the ported resolver through
  top.mcly99.dl.engine.clouddrive.CloudDriveService.
- Build dependencies added: OkHttp 4.12.0 (Apache-2.0), org.json 20240303 (JSON
  license), jcefmaven 132.3.1 (Apache-2.0) + the matching Windows JCEF natives
  + commons-compress 1.27.1 (Apache-2.0) for the in-app browser login.
- Downstream fix in data/network/XunleiApi.kt (marked "ktdown 适配", 2026-11-13):
  upstream's panCallAnonymous deliberately sends no captcha token, but the Xunlei
  anonymous share API now rejects that with captcha_invalid / "验证码无效"
  (detail: "captcha_token is empty") and requires a matching X-Client-Id header.
  KtDownload now self-signs a guest captcha token via the existing web-channel
  9-salt algorithm (initWebCaptcha), caches it per (deviceId, action) until expiry,
  adds X-Client-Id for guest pan requests, and re-signs once on captcha_invalid.
  No upstream behaviour for authenticated requests was changed.
- KtDownload UI alignment (2026-11-13, updated 2026-11-14): the "网盘列表"
  panel is a from-scratch KtDownload implementation of the per-platform
  account-card list from upstream ui/screens/DriveScreen.kt (no upstream UI
  source was copied). It keeps one Cookie/token per platform. As of 2026-11-14
  these are AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest in ~/.mclydownload/ via
  engine/clouddrive/CloudCredentialStorage.kt (upstream's SQLite account DB,
  multi-account directory and DPAPI key wrapping were still NOT ported).
  Space quota is queried for 9 platforms: the original 6 single-credential ones
  plus Xunlei / GuangYa / ILanzou, whose multi-parameter signatures are fed by
  engine/clouddrive/CloudCredentialFields.kt. Lanzou has no quota API upstream
  and is still skipped. The GitHub placeholder card was removed (the SharePlatform
  enum value remains in the ported parser); GitHub URLs are now detected in
  CloudDriveViewModel and point the user to Catch Web / Add task instead.
- In-app web login (2026-11-13): the JCEF login flow was ADAPTED (not copied
  verbatim) from upstream ui/jcef/JcefHolder.kt, ui/jcef/JcefLoginPane.kt,
  util/CookieCleaner.kt, ui/login/XunleiWebLoginScreen.kt and the *LoginScreen.kt
  login URLs / required Cookie keys. KtDownload files:
    top/mcly99/dl/engine/clouddrive/browser/JcefHolder.kt
    top/mcly99/dl/engine/clouddrive/browser/JcefCookies.kt
    top/mcly99/dl/engine/clouddrive/CloudDriveLoginConfig.kt
    top/mcly99/dl/ui/components/CloudDriveLoginScreen.kt
  Differences: no BrowserCookieImporter (JNA/DPAPI/SQLite), no separate login
  windows (full-screen overlay inside the main window), native bundle is shipped
  as the jcef-natives jar on the classpath rather than as a repacked tar.gz.
  As of 2026-11-14 credentials ARE persisted, but in an encrypted properties
  file (CloudCredentialStorage.kt, AES-256-GCM + a 0600 master-key file), NOT in
  upstream's SQLite account DB; there is still no multi-account directory,
  primary account, remark or password-protected auth backup.
  The two Xunlei bridge readers (collectXunleiCredential and the old
  collectXunleiAccessToken) were merged: cookie-share reassembly now lives only
  in XunleiDriveCredential.fromCookiePairs.
  These adapted files are AGPL-3.0 derivative works of YunX-Desktop.

Downstream changes NOT recorded before the 2026-11-14 audit
-----------------------------------------------------------
Every item below changes one of the 47 AGPL-3.0 ported files and therefore
remains an AGPL-3.0 derivative work. Evidence: docs/CLOUD_DRIVE_DIFF.md §4
(mechanical diff) and §5.1 (IDs D-01..D-10). They were found by comparing the
working tree with upstream tag v1.3.4 — not from the upstream changelog, which
is why the earlier "verbatim" wording above was misleading.

  D-01  data/network/BaiduApi.kt — +19 functions / ~+869 lines: parses the share
        page's window.yunData for shareid / share_uk / sign / timestamp / bdstoken,
        signs /share/tplconfig and calls /api/sharedownload (the web "Download"
        button) to obtain a direct link WITHOUT transferring, plus errno-branched
        transfer retries (transferOnce / parseTransferResult / transferError).
  D-02  data/repository/BaiduResolveRepository.kt — +~272 lines: two-channel
        resolver "no-save first, fall back to transfer"
        (getShareDownloadLinkWithoutSave / transferToTemp / awaitTransferred /
        freshWorkDir / findTransferred).
  D-03  data/network/BaiduConstants.kt — added apiSurl(), sharePageUrl(),
        hasStoken(), cookieKeys() and LEGACY_TEMP_DIR_NAMES = ["YunX临时转存"]
        (so a temp dir created by an older build is reused).
  D-04  data/network/BaiduApiException.kt — added `errno: Int?` for error-code
        branching in the resolver.
  D-05  TEMP_DIR_NAME "YunX临时转存" -> "MclyDownload临时转存" in QuarkConstants.kt,
        UCConstants.kt, XunleiConstants.kt, Pan115Constants.kt, BaiduConstants.kt.
        Behavioural difference: the same account creates differently named temp
        folders in the two applications.
  D-06  data/repository/ShareResolveRepository.kt — KDoc now states that both
        Quark and Baidu override getShareDownloadLinkWithoutSave.
  D-07  QuarkResolveRepository.kt / Pan115ResolveRepository.kt — KDoc updated to
        match the renamed temp dir.
  D-08  XunleiResolveRepository.kt — `if (exp > 0 && exp - now > 60) return`
        split into `if (exp <= 0) return` + `if (exp - now > 60) return`, so an
        opaque (non-JWT) token is no longer treated as expired and rotated.
  D-09  XunleiWebCredential.kt — KDoc no longer references upstream
        video.HeadlessWebView; ktdown collects bridge cookies via JcefCookies.
  D-10  Provenance headers said "release v1.3.3 era" while this file declared
        tag v1.3.4 — corrected on 2026-11-14 (see the header note above).

Already recorded before the audit: XunleiApi guest-captcha self-signing (D-11,
described above) and the ILanzouAccountRepository shim (D-12).

Changes made in the 2026-11-14 development round
------------------------------------------------
  N-01  data/repository/ShareResolveRepository.kt — added
        `val supportsSeparateNoSaveLink: Boolean = false`, overridden to true in
        QuarkResolveRepository.kt and BaiduResolveRepository.kt. The glue layer
        now asks the repository whether a separate no-save implementation exists
        instead of hard-coding a {QUARK, BAIDU} whitelist when deciding whether
        a failed no-save attempt may be retried through the transfer path.
  N-02  47 ported headers + 2 adapted JCEF headers — snapshot version corrected
        to v1.3.4 (D-10). No upstream logic was re-ported; no ported file was
        added or removed.
  N-03  data/AppContext.kt — corrected the shim comment. build.gradle.kts
        modules(...) DOES include "java.prefs", so the old claim that the jlink
        image lacks it was wrong; the properties-backed shim is a deliberate
        storage choice and stays.
  N-04  KtDownload-original glue/UI/test files (engine/clouddrive/*,
        viewmodel/, ui/components/, jvmTest/) changed in this round are NOT part
        of the 47 ported sources and need no upstream attribution. The two
        adapted JCEF login files are a separate case: they remain AGPL-3.0
        derivative works, and the logic change to one of them is recorded as
        N-05 below. Highlights: cleanupTempDir is now wired from the download
        task terminal state (CloudLink.cleanupDirFid -> CloudDriveViewModel ->
        AppViewModel.onDownloadTasksChanged), quota covers 9 platforms, credentials
        are encrypted at rest, the GitHub placeholder card is gone, netdisk
        notices are localised via CloudDriveStrings, and the upstream
        ShareLinkParserTest was ported to jvmTest.
  N-05  engine/clouddrive/browser/JcefCookies.kt (adapted JCEF login file,
        AGPL-3.0 derivative work) — removed the second Xunlei cookie assembly
        implementation `collectXunleiAccessToken()`. `collectXunleiCredential()`
        now delegates the chunk reassembly to the single ktdown-owned
        `XunleiDriveCredential.fromCookiePairs()` helper; URLDecoder and
        XunleiWebCredential imports were dropped. CloudDriveLoginScreen.kt
        (ktdown-original UI) accordingly polls only `collectXunleiCredential()`.
        This is a downstream modification to an AGPL-3.0 derivative work and is
        declared here under AGPL-3.0 §5(a); JcefHolder.kt changed only in its
        provenance header (N-02).

  N-06  Batch 1 (2026-11-14) — Chinese share commands, D-19 + D-20.
        * NEW ported upstream files (49 total now, snapshot still v1.3.4):
            data/network/StarSeaApi.kt        (upstream 125 lines)
            data/network/StarSeaConstants.kt  (upstream  29 lines)
          Both carry the standard AGPL-3.0 provenance header. StarSeaApi.kt has
          one downstream adaptation: com.yunx.app.util.Log was replaced with
          top.mcly99.dl.utils.AppLogger (the same shim as D-13); its KDoc gained
          two downstream notes. Everything else — including the Chinese
          describeFailure() messages — is verbatim. StarSeaConstants.kt is a
          package rename only. Declared here under AGPL-3.0 §5(a).
        * D-20: XunleiKouling.kt / XunleiApi.parseKouling /
          XunleiResolveRepository.resolveKouling were already among the 47
          ported files but were never called. They are now reached through
          engine/clouddrive/CloudDriveService.resolveCommand(), which mirrors
          upstream ResolveViewModel.startResolve:902-925 — try the Xunlei
          command first, fall back to StarSea, then re-parse the resulting
          share link with the existing ShareLinkParser.
        * Downstream-only glue/UI (KtDownload originals, no upstream source
          copied): CloudDriveApi.resolveCommand() returns Result<String>? where
          null means "not a command, no network request"; CloudDriveViewModel
          .resolve() defers platform/credential/root-dir selection until after
          command resolution and displays the resolved link in the result;
          UiStrings.CloudDriveStrings adds commandResolving / commandResolved /
          commandResolveFailed in both zhCN and enUS.
        * Privacy hardening not present upstream: StarSeaApi.looksLikeCommand()
          only rejects URLs and over-long text, so upstream sends essentially
          any ordinary text to the third-party service. KtDownload additionally
          requires at least one CJK character before trying StarSea.
        * Tests: jvmTest/data/network/ShareCommandTest.kt (pure logic + glue
          local branches, no network) and three new CloudDriveViewModelTest
          cases for command success / platform selection / service failure.

  N-07  Batch 2 (2026-11-14) — GitHub subsystem, D-18.
        * NEW ported upstream files (56 total now, snapshot still v1.3.4):
            data/network/GitHubApi.kt                (upstream 350 lines)
            data/network/GitHubCommitDateCache.kt   (upstream 112 lines)
            data/network/GitHubLinkParser.kt        (upstream 117 lines)
            data/network/GitHubMirror.kt            (upstream 229 lines)
            data/network/GitHubModels.kt            (upstream  70 lines)
            data/network/GitHubResponseCache.kt     (upstream  99 lines)
            data/network/GitHubTokenStore.kt        (upstream  60 lines)
                                                  --------------------
                                                  total      1,037 lines
          All seven carry AGPL-3.0 provenance headers. Verbatim except for the
          namespace change in:
            GitHubModels.kt / GitHubLinkParser.kt / GitHubResponseCache.kt /
            GitHubCommitDateCache.kt  — package rename ONLY.
            GitHubApi.kt               — two downstream changes: the User-Agent
              header identifies "MclyDownload" instead of "YunX", and the
              header records that change (N-07). All API paths, cache keys,
              TokenCheck parsing, 401 handling and JSON mapping are verbatim.
          Adapted (header says "Adapted from", with an explicit change list):
            GitHubMirror.kt — upstream SettingsRepository (data/prefs, not
              ported) replaced by ktdown's AppContext.miscPrefs / ShimPrefs;
              Log shimmed; TAG/PROBE_UA renamed; added isEnabled / setEnabled /
              setPrefix / fixedPrefix / probes / injectable prefs. BEHAVIOUR
              CHANGE (batch 2): upstream proxies EVERY GitHub download through
              a third-party gh-proxy host by default; ktdown originally
              defaulted to DIRECT (empty prefix) and only proxied after
              explicit user opt-in. SUPERSEDED by N-11 (P2, 2026-11-15):
              the default is now AUTO, but a mirror is used only after a
              successful probe — see N-11.
            GitHubTokenStore.kt — upstream FileCredentialCipher (data/security,
              not ported) replaced by ktdown's existing AES-256-GCM
              CloudDriveAccountStore.sharedStorage; added injectable
              tokenReader/tokenWriter so the account store stays the single
              source of truth; Log shimmed. The upstream "never delete on a
              failed decrypt" rule is preserved.
          Declared here under AGPL-3.0 section 5(a).
        * DELIBERATELY NOT PORTED, and why (product boundary for this batch):
            ui/components/GitHubMarkdownImageTransformer.kt (1,329 lines) —
              GFM README image rewriting/rendering. KtDownload has no Markdown
              renderer in the cloud-drive page, so README rendering is out of
              scope; no upstream code from it is present in this tree.
            ui/viewmodel/ResolveViewModel.kt GitHub section (~414 lines) and
              ui/screens/ResolveScreen.kt GitHub UI — NOT copied. The
              downstream-original engine/clouddrive/GitHubBrowser.kt reimplements
              the navigation by projecting repo trees / Releases / account repo
              lists onto ktdown's existing ShareFile list, so the existing
              search / sort / breadcrumb / multi-select / batch download UI
              serves GitHub without any upstream UI source.
        * Downstream behaviour differences in GitHubBrowser.kt (KtDownload
          original, NOT upstream code): fid "github:auto" lets one parse entry
          decide repo root vs account list vs direct file; "github:direct:<url>"
          renders a direct-file URL as a one-item list instead of upstream's
          confirm dialog; nested tree paths are joined with their parent path
          before building raw URLs (upstream uses the Git Trees API's single
          level name, which loses parent directories below level 1); draft
          Releases are hidden; prereleases are labelled; path segments are
          percent-encoded. Token is optional and only raises the API rate
          limit from 60/hour to 5,000/hour.
        * KtDownload-original glue/UI changed in this batch (no upstream source
          copied): CloudDriveService.parse() now recognises GitHub links;
          createSession / listFiles / downloadLink / rootDirFid route GITHUB to
          GitHubBrowser; CloudDriveViewModel drops its three hard GitHub blocks;
          CloudDriveCatalog restores the GitHub card as an optional-token card
          and supportsCredential() is now true for every platform;
          CloudDriveScreen adds the previously unwired credential editor
          (password-masked) and a mirror selection row; UiStrings gains the
          GitHub strings in both zhCN and enUS; GitHubMirror.ensureFresh() runs
          only when the user has enabled mirroring.
        * Tests (all zero-network): jvmTest/data/network/GitHubLinkParserTest.kt,
          GitHubResponseCacheTest.kt, GitHubMirrorTest.kt (injects a temp
          ShimPrefs), GitHubTokenStoreTest.kt (injects in-memory reader/writer),
          and jvmTest/engine/clouddrive/GitHubBrowserTest.kt (FakeSource covers
          roots, nested trees, ZIP, Releases/assets, account->repo navigation,
          direct files, mirror prefixes and the CloudDriveService routing).

  N-08  Batch 0 (2026-11-14) — D-29 leftovers (link history / bookmarks) and
        the D-36 / D-48 test gaps. NO new upstream source was ported in this
        batch: the ported file count stays at 56 and no AGPL-3.0 file changed.
        Upstream's bookmark feature (ui/screens/BookmarkScreen.kt 659 lines,
        LinkHistoryDialog.kt, BookmarkViewModel.kt and the SQLite
        BookmarkEntity / DAO) was DELIBERATELY NOT COPIED; upstream's "preview"
        is a ffplay-based video overlay (ui/components/VideoPreviewOverlay.kt)
        that belongs to the D-21 video module, also out of scope here.
        KtDownload-original additions instead:
          engine/clouddrive/CloudLinkLibrary.kt — local JSON store at
            ~/.mclydownload/cloud-links.json, owner-only permissions, atomic
            replace, 30-entry history / 100-entry bookmark caps, corrupt-file
            degradation, injectable dir/clock. Share text with passcodes never
            leaves the machine.
          viewmodel/CloudDriveViewModel.kt — linkHistory / bookmarks /
            linkPicker state, reuseEntry(), toggleCurrentBookmark(), remove /
            clear actions; a successful resolve records the EFFECTIVE link
            (i.e. the real URL produced from a Chinese share command, so reuse
            does not contact the third-party command service again). reuseEntry()
            clears the previous passcode (including a manually typed one) and
            goes through updateUrl() so the new link's pwd= is auto-filled.
          ui/components/HeaderBar.kt + AppNew.kt — history / bookmark buttons
            in the cloud-drive header; ui/components/CloudDriveScreen.kt —
            LinkPickerDialog, per-entry removal, clear-all and a bookmark
            toggle on the result pane; theme/UiStrings.kt — 9 new strings in
            both zhCN and enUS.
          engine/clouddrive/CloudDriveService.kt — added a nullable
            repositoryOverride constructor argument (production default null)
            so the three download-link paths can be unit-tested with a fake;
            createRepository() itself is unchanged.
        Tests (all zero-network): jvmTest/engine/clouddrive/
        CloudLinkLibraryTest.kt, CloudDriveServiceDownloadLinkTest.kt,
        engine/RateLimiterTest.kt, engine/ProxySupportTest.kt, plus new
        CloudDriveViewModelTest cases for history / bookmarks / quota-refresh
        failure isolation and stale-job cancellation.

  N-09  In-app attribution (2026-11-14) — closes the last non-owner-decision
        TODO in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. NO new upstream source was ported and
        NO AGPL-3.0 file changed: the count stays at 56. A repository-root
        notice is invisible to end users, so AGPL-3.0 §5(a)/§13 attribution is
        now also rendered in the app. KtDownload-original additions only:
          theme/LicenseStrings.kt — bilingual (zhCN / enUS) data table with 4
            third-party components (FFmpeg LGPL-3.0-or-later, VLC/libvlc
            LGPL-2.1, JCEF/Chromium Apache-2.0 / BSD-style, YunX-Desktop
            AGPL-3.0). The AGPL entry carries the upstream project + URL,
            snapshot v1.3.4 @ 00a030f7, 56 files / 13,670 lines, the path to
            SOURCE.txt (downstream modifications) and LICENSE.txt (full text).
            A prominent warning states that the root MIT LICENSE is not
            sufficient, the §13 decision is pending, and no binary from this
            branch may be published. Mounted as ONE grouped field on UiStrings
            because that data class is near the JVM 255-parameter limit.
          ui/components/OpenSourceLicensesDialog.kt — renders the table;
            "Open license folder" opens the parent of FfmpegLocator's ffmpeg
            directory, which also holds vlc/ and yunx-desktop/ license texts.
          ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt — the button now opens the dialog
            instead of just launching the file manager on the FFmpeg folder.
          jvmTest/theme/LicenseStringsTest.kt — locks the attribution markers,
            zh/en parity, and the existence of all 3 bundled license texts.
        THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md §"In-app attribution" records the same. The
        OWNER DECISION TODO (relicense vs. process isolation) is deliberately
        STILL OPEN and the root LICENSE remains untouched.

  N-10  P1 network settings (2026-11-15) — HTTP/2 wiring and the three-state
        proxy. NO new upstream source was ported: the count stays at 56.
        ONE AGPL-3.0 file changed:
          data/network/HttpClients.kt — setProxy(Proxy?) now keeps the
            java.net.Proxy object (SOCKS is no longer flattened to host/port);
            add setProxyProvider(() -> Proxy?) for live resolution; compare an
            address fingerprint in apiClient()/downloadClient() so a changed
            system proxy rebuilds the cached clients; setHttp2Enabled() still
            clears the caches. The protocol switch itself was already there —
            what was missing was any caller.
        KtDownload-original additions (NOT upstream files): model/ProxyMode.kt,
          data/network/PlatformProxyDetector.kt, theme/NetworkStrings.kt,
          engine/ProxySupport.kt resolveProxy(), plus SettingsRepository /
          AppViewModel / DownloadViewModel / DownloadEngine / SettingsScreen
          wiring and 4 new jvmTest suites. PlatformProxyDetector is a
          cross-platform rewrite (macOS scutil --proxy, Windows reg query,
          Linux env/gsettings/ProxySelector); upstream's SystemProxy.kt is
          Windows-only JNA and was deliberately NOT copied.
        The in-app attribution (LicenseStrings.kt, N-09) still reports the
        unchanged 56-file / 13,670-line upstream snapshot.

  N-11  P2 GitHub mirror default (2026-11-15) — closes CLOUD_DRIVE_GAP.md
        1.6. NO new upstream source was ported: the count stays at 56.
        ONE AGPL-3.0 file changed:
          data/network/GitHubMirror.kt — default of isEnabled() flipped from
            false to true (an older explicit "direct" choice is persisted and
            still wins); activePrefix() no longer falls back to PRESETS.first()
            when no probe result exists, so an untested mirror can never enter
            a download URL; when every probe fails the prefix is empty (GitHub
            direct); a failed round uses a 10-minute retry TTL instead of 6
            hours; ensureFresh() skips probing when the user fixed a preset or
            chose direct. Added injectable prober/clock, the synchronous
            applyProbeResults() / shouldRefresh() helpers and resetForTest()
            for offline tests. The five-mirror throughput probe itself, the
            88MB Range sample and PRESETS are unchanged upstream logic.
        PRIVACY BOUNDARY: only PUBLIC GitHub download URLs (raw.githubusercontent
          / codeload / release assets) can carry a mirror prefix; api.github.com
          metadata requests are never routed through a third party. The
          cloud-drive page now displays the actually active mirror (or
          "direct") so traffic is visible, and an explicit "Direct" choice
          disables probing entirely. A 256KB Range probe per mirror is sent
          at startup (6h TTL, 10min after a failed round) unless disabled.
        KtDownload-original wiring (NOT upstream files): CloudDriveService,
          CloudDriveViewModel, CloudDriveScreen MirrorRow, AppViewModel and
          the zh/en CloudDriveStrings rows. GitHubMirrorTest now covers 10
          offline cases including both TTLs and the settings round-trip.

  N-12  P3 multi-account pool + C1 rotation (2026-11-15) — closes
        CLOUD_DRIVE_GAP.md 1.1 / 2.1 / 2.2 (C1 only; C2 remains out of scope).
        NO new upstream source was ported and NO AGPL-3.0 file was modified:
        the count stays at 56 files / 13,670 lines. The user explicitly chose
        a self-authored encrypted account pool over copying the upstream
        14-table SQLite schema (whose strict key tier depends on Windows DPAPI
        and does not apply to macOS/Linux).
        KtDownload-original additions (NOT upstream files):
          engine/clouddrive/CloudAccountPool.kt — CloudAccount / CloudAccount
            Storage plus InMemory and File implementations. Encrypted
            properties with composite keys acct|<PLATFORM>|<id> -> v2:<iv>:<ct>
            (AES-256-GCM, 12-byte IV, 128-bit tag, AAD bound to platform AND
            account id, 0700 dir / 0600 files, tmp + ATOMIC_MOVE); plaintext
            metadata under meta|<PLATFORM>|<id> caches nickname / remark /
            isPrimary / updatedAt. Reuses the existing 32-byte
            cloud-credentials.key with a distinct purpose prefix.
          engine/clouddrive/CloudDriveAccounts.kt — CloudDriveAccountStore
            keeps every legacy API mapped to the primary account, adds
            addAccount / setPrimary / rename / remove / updateCredential /
            accountsFor / allCredentials; migrates the old single credential
            to a primary account on first launch and keeps writing a
            primary-account projection to CloudCredentialStorage so
            GitHubTokenStore and an older build still work.
          model/Models.kt + data/SettingsRepository.kt — multiAccountDownload
            switch, DEFAULT OFF, persisted; theme/MultiAccountStrings.kt is a
            standalone zh/en table (UiStrings is at the JVM 255-parameter
            limit); ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt hosts the switch.
          viewmodel/CloudDriveViewModel.kt — credentialRotation() rotates a
            de-duplicated credential pool per FILE (primary first), skips
            guest / GitHub / single-account cases, never retries a failed
            file on another account, and passes the SAME credential to
            cleanup registration; activeCredential lets bindCredentialSink
            write a refreshed token back to the account actually used.
          ui/components/CloudDriveScreen.kt — AccountPanel for list / primary
            badge / set-primary / remark / sign-out / add; startAddAccount
            reuses the in-app JCEF login, normal re-login still overwrites
            the primary (mirrors upstream resolveAccountSlot).
          jvmTest: CloudAccountPoolTest, MultiAccountStringsTest, plus new
            C1 and account-panel cases in CloudDriveViewModelTest and
            SettingsRepositoryTest.
        Upstream review note: B:ResolveViewModel.kt assembles pendingAltLinks
          for C2 but never passes it to enqueueDownload — upstream C2 is
          effectively inert; if C2 is ever implemented downstream that wire
          must be added rather than copied as-is.
        The in-app attribution (LicenseStrings.kt, N-09) still reports the
        unchanged 56-file / 13,670-line upstream snapshot.

  N-13  C2 single-file multi-source chunk download (2026-11-15) — closes
        CLOUD_DRIVE_GAP.md 2.2 (C2). NO new upstream source was ported and
        NO AGPL-3.0 file was modified: the count stays at 56 files /
        13,670 lines. This is the wire the upstream review found missing:
        B:ResolveViewModel.kt builds pendingAltLinks but never passes it to
        enqueueDownload, so upstream C2 is inert.
        KtDownload-original additions (NOT upstream files):
          model/DownloadSource.kt — a (URL + full header set) pair. The URL
            and the session Cookie are bound together, so the engine can
            never swap a URL while keeping another account's Cookie.
          model/DownloadTask.kt / engine/clouddrive/CloudModels.kt —
            altSources on the task and on CloudLink; only held in memory.
          viewmodel/CloudDriveViewModel.kt — prefetches one alternative
            link per extra account for the SAME file, limited to QUARK / UC /
            XUNLEI / BAIDU with 2+ accounts, guarded by both C1 and C2
            switches; passes altSources to onDownload together with the
            primary link and registers cleanups for prefetch temp dirs.
          engine/DownloadEngine.kt — downloadSources() returns
            List<Pair<String, RequestAuth>>; chunks rotate over sources and
            retry on a different source after a failure.
          engine/TaskStore.kt — deliberately DOES NOT persist altSources or
            any Cookie. A multiSource=1 marker restores such tasks as FAILED
            with MULTI_SOURCE_NOT_PERSISTED_MESSAGE (signed links expire).
          model/Models.kt + data/SettingsRepository.kt — multiSourceDownload
            switch, DEFAULT OFF; the read/write paths enforce c1 && c2.
          theme/MultiAccountStrings.kt / ui/components/SettingsScreen.kt —
            the C2 switch and its "requires C1" warning, standalone zh/en.
          viewmodel/DownloadViewModel.kt / AppViewModel.kt — pass-through.
          jvmTest: DownloadEngineMultiSourceTest (new), plus new cases in
            TaskStoreTest, CloudDriveViewModelTest, SettingsRepositoryTest,
            MultiAccountStringsTest and DownloadEngineIntegrationTest.

  N-15  v1.3.4 release-notes audit + hidden-pitfall fixes (2026-11-15) —
        see docs/UPSTREAM_SYNC_2026-11-15.md. GitHub origin/main was checked
        again and is STILL 00a030f778a65840e9be65baecb15497a94b04ec (zero new
        commits since the v1.3.4 baseline), so this batch aligns *fixes* from
        the v1.3.4 release notes rather than chasing a newer version.
        NO new upstream source was ported and NO AGPL-3.0 file was modified:
        the count stays at 56 files / 13,670 lines and the root LICENSE is
        untouched. Every file below is KtDownload-original work.

        (1) Non-ASCII HTTP header values (upstream 1830497). Upstream cleaned
            browser-plugin Cookie values before OkHttp header validation.
            Downstream collects cookies via CDP Network.getAllCookies, which
            can carry the same Chinese/emoji values. New engine/
            HttpHeaderValues.kt accepts only visible ASCII (0x20..0x7E) and
            percent-encodes everything else as UTF-8 (also CRLF/TAB/controls,
            closing header injection). All four HttpURLConnection call sites
            (engine/DownloadEngine.kt, engine/hls/HlsDownloader.kt,
            engine/web/HttpProbe.kt, engine/web/WebPageFetcher.kt) now use
            setSafeHeader(); engine/web/browser/BrowserCapture.kt sanitizes
            CDP cookie values at ingress; engine/clouddrive/
            CloudDriveService.useCredential() sanitizes cookie-like login
            credentials but explicitly SPARES structured JSON credentials
            (Xunlei), which must stay parseable. No ported *Api.kt was edited.

        (2) Resume plan drift (same failure class as upstream d1b888f).
            Upstream fixed overlapping *elastic* chunks; downstream has no
            elastic allocator at all, but changing the thread count or a
            changed remote length makes fixed .partN/.offset files belong to
            a DIFFERENT byte range. Merging them produces a silently corrupt
            file. New engine/DownloadFileSupport.kt helpers write a
            <name>.chunks.plan signature (total|count|threads); engine/
            DownloadEngine.kt calls reconcileChunkPlan() before chunking,
            discards stale parts (including legacy tasks with no plan),
            clears the plan after a successful merge / task removal, and
            cleans abandoned multi-thread parts when switching to one thread.

        (3) Shut down when downloads finish (upstream 3700c1c / PR #75-era
            release notes). New utils/DesktopActions.kt, theme/
            ShutdownStrings.kt, viewmodel/ShutdownAfterCompleteController.kt
            and ui/components/ShutdownCountdownDialog.kt; model/Models.kt +
            data/SettingsRepository.kt persist shutdownAfterComplete (default
            OFF); SettingsScreen.kt / AppNew.kt / viewmodel/AppViewModel.kt
            wire the switch and the always-on countdown dialog. Self-authored
            state machine: only arms after a task really ran, requires a
            drained queue with no user-paused task, counts MERGING as busy,
            cancels on new tasks / switch off / explicit cancel, and fires a
            ONE-SHOT immediate shutdown when the in-app 60s countdown ends
            (deliberately NOT a system-level scheduled shutdown that could
            outlive a crashed app). No upstream UI or ViewModel was ported.

        (4) Startup diagnostics / exit stability (upstream 3700c1c). main.kt
            now logs diagnostic_session_start / diagnostic_session_end pairs,
            read-only harvests hs_err_pid*.log / replay_pid*.log key lines
            from the working dir and APP_DATA_DIR (does NOT move or delete
            user files), and suppresses the native error dialog for
            exceptions raised after shutdown begins.

        jvmTest additions: HttpHeaderValuesTest, ChunkPlanTest,
        DownloadEngineChunkPlanTest, ShutdownAfterCompleteControllerTest,
        ShutdownStringsTest; SettingsRepositoryTest extended.
        WebUploadServerTest was hardened against an unrelated flake (JDK
        keep-alive connections cached by host:port can outlive a recycled
        ephemeral test port); it now retries on SocketException with a fresh
        connection, with no change to the server under test. All offline /
        local-HTTP only — real OS shutdown permission and real cloud cookies
        containing non-ASCII text were NOT verified on a real machine.
        The in-app attribution (LicenseStrings.kt, N-09) still reports the
        unchanged 56-file / 13,670-line upstream snapshot.

  N-16  P2 capability batch + two real defects (2026-11-15) — closes the
        remaining P2 rows of docs/UPSTREAM_SYNC_2026-11-15.md §3 and
        docs/CLOUD_DRIVE_GAP.md 2.6 / 2.9. Again NO upstream source was
        ported and NO AGPL-3.0 file was modified: the count stays at
        56 files / 13,670 lines, the root LICENSE is untouched, and the
        in-app attribution still reports the same snapshot. Every file
        below is KtDownload-original work.

        (0) Two real defects found while doing (1)-(3), fixed first because
            they silently lose user data:
            * Duplicate account stores. viewmodel/AppViewModel.kt built one
              CloudDriveAccountStore for the shared-link pool and the
              "My Drive" page built a second one; persist() writes a FULL
              snapshot, so the two instances overwrote each other and
              accounts vanished on restart. engine/clouddrive/
              CloudDriveAccounts.kt now exposes a process-wide
              CloudDriveAccountStore.shared, AppViewModel passes it into
              both CloudDriveViewModel and MyDriveViewModel, and the default
              constructor argument of both ViewModels points at the same
              instance.
            * "My Drive" pagination. 139 / 123 list APIs are cursor based;
              viewmodel/MyDriveViewModel.kt only ever read page 1, so files
              past the first page were invisible and unselectable.
              nextCursor / loadMore() / hasMore were added, dedup is by
              remote id, cursors reset on dir change / platform change /
              account change, and the "move to folder" picker now aggregates
              up to 20 pages (MOVE_FOLDER_MAX_PAGES). FileList shows
              "load more" only when hasMore.

        (1) Passphrase-encrypted account backup / restore (GAP 2.6). New
            engine/clouddrive/CloudAccountBackup.kt: PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256
            (16-byte salt, 210,000 iterations) -> AES-256-GCM (12-byte IV,
            128-bit tag), AAD bound to the magic + format version + KDF +
            iteration count, so downgrading the header fails the tag check
            instead of silently weakening the file. Payload carries every
            account of every platform with nickname, remark, primary flag
            and credential; reimport MERGES (dedup by platform+credential,
            id collisions get a fresh id, nothing is overwritten) via
            CloudDriveAccountStore.mergeAll(). Wrong passphrase and
            tampering both report "wrong passphrase or corrupted backup";
            a newer format version or a foreign file is rejected outright.
            Written to a .tmp then atomically replaced, mode 0600.

        (2) One-click diagnostics bundle + crash artifacts (GAP 2.9). New
            utils/DiagnosticBundle.kt builds kt-diagnostics-<ts>.zip with
            manifest.txt / environment.txt / settings.txt / logs (last 7
            days) / crash, NEVER credentials (account export is the only
            path that carries them, and only encrypted, only on request),
            never dumps environment variables, and redacts the home
            directory to "~". New utils/CrashLogs.kt archives
            hs_err_pid* / replay_pid* into <data>/logs/crash by COPYING
            (source files are never moved or deleted) and is now what
            main.kt calls at startup instead of its old inline scan.
            ui/components/DataToolsSection.kt surfaces export / import /
            diagnostics in Settings behind a masked passphrase dialog;
            theme/DataToolsStrings.kt is a standalone zh/en table so
            UiStrings keeps its distance from the JVM 255-parameter limit.

        (3) Full share-expiry tiers (GAP §3 P2). MyDriveCapabilities gained
            shareExpiryTiers (per-platform, empty = hide the picker) and
            sharePasscode; MyDriveAdapters declares DEFAULT_SHARE_TIERS for
            platforms that accept the neutral ShareExpire codes, PAN115's
            own 101..105 scale for 115, and none at all for ILanzou (the
            server decides). The ShareDialog now renders radios from the
            platform's real tiers instead of a hardcoded 2-item list, and
            hides the passcode field where the platform cannot use one.

        (4) Deliberately NOT done: native Windows toast progress
            notifications. They need WinRT via PowerShell or a JNA binding,
            which cannot be verified on this macOS machine, and the existing
            tray balloon is already wired. Recorded as a product boundary in
            docs/CLOUD_DRIVE_GAP.md 2.8 rather than shipped untested.

        jvmTest additions: CloudAccountBackupTest, MyDriveShareExpiryTest,
        SharedAccountStoreTest, DiagnosticBundleTest, CrashLogsTest,
        MyDrivePaginationTest, DataToolsStringsTest; MyDriveStringsTest
        extended with every expiry code. All offline — no real account was
        used to verify the new settings UI on a real machine.

  N-17  Dangerous-path guard for recursive deletes (2026-11-15) — reviewed
        upstream's "wiped the whole F: drive" incident (v1.3.3 storage-dir
        migration plus startup cleanup of the old location). The v1.3.4
        release notes describe the fix as: a cache/data directory set to a
        drive root would move the entire drive, so migration now only moves
        the app's own entries, and the startup cleanup refuses drive roots,
        ancestors of the current data directory, and targets that contain
        user files. NO upstream code was read into the build and NO
        AGPL-3.0 file was modified: still 56 files / 13,670 lines, root
        LICENSE untouched.

        Downstream does NOT have the three upstream conditions: there is no
        configurable storage/cache directory (AppSettings has only
        downloadPath, which decides where files are written and is never
        used to delete a directory), no directory migration (no
        copyRecursively anywhere), and no startup cleanup of an "old data
        directory". So the incident cannot happen here — but only because
        those features were never built, not because the delete path was
        ever guarded. This entry adds the guard so a future feature cannot
        reintroduce it:

        (1) New utils/SafeDelete.kt is the ONLY entry point for recursive
            deletion. It refuses when: the target has no name / no parent
            (drive root, "/", "C:"), the user home is inside the target,
            the app data dir is inside the target, or the entry count
            exceeds 50,000 (a real HLS playlist is a few thousand at most,
            so a bigger number means the path was miscalculated). Paths are
            compared after toRealPath(), so a symlink pointing at the home
            directory is refused too. Missing targets are a silent no-op.

        (2) All six recursive-delete sites now go through it: DownloadEngine
            (cleanupHlsSegments / cancel / removeTask / post-mux cleanup, 4
            sites), engine/hls/FfmpegMuxer.kt and
            engine/web/browser/BrowserCapture.kt (Chromium temp profile,
            previously a manual Files.walk in reverse order).
            After the change, "deleteRecursively" appears in exactly one
            place in jvmMain: SafeDelete.kt itself.

        (3) hlsSegmentDir() no longer degenerates to a path relative to the
            process CWD when the task target has no parent (F:\ or /):
            File(null, ".hls") put segments somewhere unrelated to the task
            and pointed later cleanup at the wrong place.

        jvmTest additions: SafeDeleteTest (8 cases; the root-directory case
        only asserts the verdict and deliberately never issues a real
        recursive delete on a root), DownloadFileSupportTest extended with
        the root-target fallback.

Upstream disclaimer (docs/DISCLAIMER.md), summarised for downstream users:
non-commercial study/research only; any paid copy is a scam; the app stores or
distributes no copyrighted content and only resolves user-supplied share links
(delete downloads within 24h); it is NOT affiliated with Quark / UC / Xunlei /
Baidu / 139 / 123 / 115 / Lanzou and reverse-engineered APIs may break at any
time; third-party clients can trigger platform account risk-control (especially
Baidu); users must comply with local law and platform terms; supplied "as is"
without warranty; use constitutes acceptance. Full text is in the upstream
repository and in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.

IMPORTANT — license obligations
--------------------------------
AGPL-3.0 is a strong network copyleft. Because the resolver is compiled into the
same application, the whole KtDownload program is a derivative work and, when
distributed (or, for a network-service build, offered over a network), must be
licensed under AGPL-3.0 with its complete Corresponding Source made available.
The project root LICENSE (MIT) is therefore NOT sufficient for distributions
that include this module. Either relicense the whole program under AGPL-3.0, or
isolate the resolver into a separate AGPL-licensed process with an arm-length
protocol, after obtaining legal review.
OWNER DECISION (2026-11-14): the root LICENSE stays MIT for now and the
provenance record is being completed, but the conflict itself is NOT resolved.
Do not publish a binary built from this branch until that decision is made;
see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md §YunX for the outstanding TODO.
